_about: The 12 issues and the fixed rubric the spectrum scorer uses. Scale: -1.0 = furthest left position commonly held in U.S. politics, 0 = center, +1.0 = furthest right. Anchors describe policy positions only, never people or parties. The same rubric is applied to every candidate.

issues.label: Abortion
issues.covers: legal access to abortion, limits by stage of pregnancy, public funding, related state and federal laws

anchors.-1.0: Abortion legal at any stage with public funding; remove existing restrictions
anchors.-0.5: Protect legal access (e.g., codify Roe-era protections) with some limits late in pregnancy
anchors.0.0: Leave to states or support access early in pregnancy with broader limits later
anchors.0.5: Restrict abortion after an early point in pregnancy, with exceptions (rape, incest, life of the mother)
anchors.1.0: Ban abortion nationwide with few or no exceptions

issues.label: Climate & Environment
issues.covers: climate change, emissions, energy sources, environmental regulation, conservation

anchors.-1.0: Rapid mandatory phase-out of fossil fuels; large public investment in clean energy (e.g., Green New Deal)
anchors.-0.5: Binding emissions targets and clean-energy incentives with a gradual transition
anchors.0.0: Mix of energy sources; market incentives; moderate regulation
anchors.0.5: Prioritize energy costs and domestic oil and gas; reduce environmental regulation
anchors.1.0: Oppose climate regulation and emissions mandates; expand fossil fuel production

issues.label: Crime & Justice
issues.covers: policing, bail, sentencing, prisons, public safety

anchors.-1.0: Shift funding from police to social services; end cash bail; large cuts to incarceration
anchors.-0.5: Criminal justice reform (bail, sentencing, police accountability) alongside policing
anchors.0.0: Balance reform with support for police funding
anchors.0.5: Expand police funding and staffing; roll back bail and sentencing reforms
anchors.1.0: Maximum enforcement: tougher sentences, expanded detention, few reform measures

issues.label: Economy, Jobs & Taxes
issues.covers: employment, minimum wage, taxes, government spending, cost of living

anchors.-1.0: Large tax increases on high earners and corporations; much higher minimum wage; major public programs
anchors.-0.5: Raise taxes on top earners; raise minimum wage; expand targeted public programs
anchors.0.0: Targeted tax relief and spending; moderate wage policy
anchors.0.5: Broad tax cuts; reduce spending and regulation; oppose minimum wage mandates
anchors.1.0: Deep tax and spending cuts; abolish major federal agencies or taxes

issues.label: Education
issues.covers: public schools, school funding, school choice, college costs, curriculum

anchors.-1.0: Large public school funding increases; free public college; oppose school vouchers
anchors.-0.5: Increase public school funding; expand pre-K; limits on charters and vouchers
anchors.0.0: Support both public schools and some school choice
anchors.0.5: Expand school choice and vouchers; parental control over curriculum
anchors.1.0: Shift funding to private and home schooling; abolish the federal education department

issues.label: Gun Laws
issues.covers: background checks, assault-style weapons, permits, concealed carry

anchors.-1.0: Ban and buy back assault-style weapons; strict licensing for all guns
anchors.-0.5: Universal background checks, red-flag laws, assault-style weapons ban
anchors.0.0: Some new checks while protecting existing gun rights
anchors.0.5: Oppose new gun restrictions; expand concealed carry

issues.label: Healthcare
issues.covers: insurance coverage, Medicaid, Medicare, drug prices, public health

anchors.-1.0: Single-payer system (Medicare for All) replacing private insurance
anchors.-0.5: Expand public coverage (public option, Medicaid expansion), lower drug prices
anchors.0.0: Keep current mix of public and private coverage with targeted fixes
anchors.0.5: Market-based reforms; reduce federal role; limit Medicaid growth
anchors.1.0: Repeal federal coverage programs and mandates

issues.label: Housing
issues.covers: rent, home prices, zoning, public and affordable housing, homelessness

anchors.-1.0: Universal rent control; large public housing build-out; housing as a guaranteed right
anchors.-0.5: Tenant protections plus public funding for affordable housing
anchors.0.0: Mix of zoning reform, incentives for builders, and targeted aid
anchors.0.5: Deregulate building and zoning; lower property taxes; oppose rent control
anchors.1.0: Remove government from housing markets; end public housing subsidies

issues.label: Immigration
issues.covers: border security, deportation, legal immigration, sanctuary policies

anchors.-1.0: Broad legalization; end most deportations; abolish ICE
anchors.-0.5: Path to citizenship plus border security; support sanctuary policies
anchors.0.0: Pair stronger border enforcement with expanded legal pathways
anchors.0.5: Prioritize border enforcement; end sanctuary policies; reduce immigration
anchors.1.0: Mass deportation; sharply cut legal immigration

issues.label: Foreign Policy
issues.covers: Israel, Iran, Ukraine, military aid, alliances, trade, war powers

anchors.-1.0: Cut military aid broadly; condition aid to Israel; prioritize diplomacy over force
anchors.-0.5: Support allies with conditions; diplomacy-first approach to Iran
anchors.0.0: Mainstream bipartisan support for allies and sanctions
anchors.0.5: Strong unconditional support for Israel; maximum pressure on Iran
anchors.1.0: Most aggressive military posture toward adversaries

issues.note: Foreign policy does not divide neatly into left and right (for example, some candidates on both sides favor less foreign involvement). The scorer reports low confidence when a stance does not fit the anchors.

anchors.-1.0: Expand protections in all areas, including gender-affirming care and sports participation
anchors.-0.5: Support federal anti-discrimination protections (e.g., Equality Act)
anchors.0.0: Support marriage equality; mixed on other policies
anchors.0.5: Limit transgender participation in sports and gender-affirming care for minors
anchors.1.0: Roll back legal protections, including marriage equality

issues.label: Women's & Children's Rights
issues.covers: equal pay, child care, paid leave, child welfare, family policy (abortion is its own issue)

anchors.-1.0: Universal publicly funded child care and paid leave; strong equal-pay mandates
anchors.-0.5: Expand child care subsidies, paid leave, and child tax credits
anchors.0.0: Targeted family support with limited new mandates
anchors.0.5: Family support mainly through tax credits; oppose new employer mandates
anchors.1.0: Oppose government child care and leave programs
